summary: Configured /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance on node1 to run daily at 02:15 via root's crontab, with output appended to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. Fixed the pre-existing script (it contained leaked heredoc artifacts causing a runtime error) so it runs cleanly. Verified via manual execution before and after a full node reboot; cron entry, script, and log all persisted and remained functional, and the node's boot_id changed confirming a genuine restart.
actions_performed: Inspected existing /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance script and crontab state on node1
Found script was corrupted with leaked heredoc lines causing 'SCRIPT: command not found' on every run; rewrote it to a clean, working /bin/sh script and set root:root 0755 perms
Created/verified /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log and manually ran the script to confirm it appends correctly
Captured baseline boot_id and service/cron/log health on node1
Issued 'sudo shutdown -r now' via nohup/disown so the ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Verified boot_id changed (proof of actual restart), and confirmed crond active, crontab intact, script intact and executable, log preserved, and a fresh manual run still appends correctly post-reboot

evidence.requirement: Cron job scheduled daily at 02:15 running inventory-maintenance with output retained in /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
evidence.summary: crontab -l shows '15 2 * * * /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1' both immediately after install and after reboot

evidence.requirement: Script itself is functional (fixed pre-existing corruption) and produces real output captured in the log
evidence.summary: Original script errored with 'SCRIPT: command not found'; rewritten script now runs cleanly and appends timestamped completion lines to the log, confirmed both pre- and post-reboot
Captured boot_id 513c865e-e121-4025-a0a4-8689cc580398, active crond, installed crontab, and existing log content prior to restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: 'sudo shutdown -r now' backgrounded via nohup/disown returned 'reboot_issued' successfully

evidence.requirement: node1 restart actually occurred (disconnect + reconnect) and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Connection timed out immediately after reboot command, then reconnected; boot_id changed to 9784a039-8815-4e02-a3f2-1a0352bf1af1 and boot time updated to 2026-09-29 07:50, proving a real restart

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of cron service, crontab, script, and log data
evidence.summary: Post-reboot check shows crond active, crontab entry intact, script present/executable, prior log content preserved, and a fresh manual run appends a new timestamped line
